HolobikeDeployment.reason: This repository. It is the specification of the deployed stack, the machine that realizes it, and the record of what it realized — none of which is deployed software. It reaches no device and no server, so it fails the membership rule on its own terms, which is the correct result: a tool that composed itself would be counting its own bytes as product. Recorded rather than skipped implicitly, because the scan should not need to know where it is running from.

HolobikeMigration_uplugin.reason: Every module in it exists to be deleted. It holds the substitutes and tooling that keep HolobikeExperience content working mid-migration; its own README says none of it is product code and none of it ships. What remains is one UncookedOnly module, which cannot enter a cooked package, so it reaches no deployment destination and fails the membership rule outright. HolobikeExperience.uproject still enables it, which makes it a required development checkout — and a required checkout is not thereby a member.
HolobikeMigration_uplugin.retires_when: HolobikeExperience.uproject no longer enables it. By the plugin's own written condition the remaining editor module is deleted once the last substitute module is, and both substitutes are already retired: IdentityMock in c6a28e9 (2026-08-13) and SimulatedRealityMock in 62ad2f8 (2026-08-19).

HolobikeIntelligence_uplugin.reason: The Unreal Engine client for the local drAIs service. It would pass the membership rule — it is HoloBike-owned software that ships inside HolobikeExperience's package exactly as the other five plugins do — and it is simply not enrolled yet, with the drAIs integration still in flight. Recorded as a candidate rather than an exclusion so the gap is a decision someone owes rather than an oversight.

HoloBikeCore-LFS.reason: The legacy Unreal demo HolobikeExperience was forked from, kept for its history and its vendored plugin copies. Superseded by the member it became; nothing composes it, and its vendored plugin trees are the reason ue/plugins must contain nothing else before one AdditionalPluginDirectories entry can scan it (D-09).

HolobikeCopresenceService.reason: Not classified. The checkout carries no README and nothing in this repository composes it, so whether it is HoloBike-owned software that ships, an experiment, or an abandoned start has not been established. Listed so the stray scan does not report it as a discovery every run while the question stands, and flagged here as a question rather than dressed up as a decision.

uroborOS-audit.reason: A working copy of uroborOS used for an audit pass, carrying no README of its own. It is the same software as the member, not different software; composing it would double-count the OS layer.

uroborOS-refactor.reason: A working copy of uroborOS carrying refactor work in progress. The same software as the member; the composition selects uroborOS at a revision, which is how in-flight work reaches the stack.

drAIs-backup.reason: A backup copy of drAIs. The same software as the member, kept against loss; a revision line selects drAIs at a commit, which is the supported way to reach an older state.

helgafell_operator.reason: The local operations workspace for the Helgafell workstation and its attached peripherals. Machine-local operator tooling that ships to no device and no server, and is therefore not part of the deployed stack by the membership rule.

RidePathsProto.reason: An interaction-design instrument — a UE-imitating editor shell in Three.js used to design the RidePaths surface. A design tool, not product code: nothing it produces reaches a device or a server.

drAIs-Lab.reason: A transitional Lab repository: specification, ledger and experiments for drAIs. Lab repositories are never composition dependencies, which Assembler/README.md already states; the member repository is where anything they settle lands.

HolobikeCore-Lab.reason: A transitional Lab repository for HolobikeCore. Lab repositories are never composition dependencies; what they settle lands in the member repository.

HexAtlas-Lab.reason: A transitional Lab repository for HexAtlas. Lab repositories are never composition dependencies; what they settle lands in the member repository.

AthleteIdentity-Lab.reason: A transitional Lab repository for AthleteIdentity. Lab repositories are never composition dependencies; what they settle lands in the member repository.

AthleteInsights-Lab.reason: A transitional Lab repository for AthleteInsights. Lab repositories are never composition dependencies; what they settle lands in the member repository.

uroborOS-Lab.reason: A transitional Lab repository for uroborOS. Lab repositories are never composition dependencies; what they settle lands in the member repository.

RidePaths-Lab.reason: A transitional Lab repository holding the RidePaths specification and its ledger. RidePaths is a module of HolobikeWorlds, which is the member; the Lab is never a composition dependency.
